name: emet
description: EMET is an MCP memory server built for ISO 9001 / ISO 13485 document control: persistent, shared memory for AI agents and bot teams. Nothing is deleted; records are superseded, retired and retained. Per-client attribution on every write and a GEM socket for add-on modules. Connects to your own self-hosted EMET server over remote HTTP with OAuth.

EMET_URL.title: Your EMET server URL
EMET_URL.description: Full MCP endpoint of your own EMET server. Paste the whole URL, for example https://their-host/mcp, not the bare host. See docs/DEPLOY.md.
